# loro-prosemirror

This directory contains a modified copy of [loro-prosemirror](https://github.com/loro-dev/loro-prosemirror) 0.4.3 by the Loro authors, distributed under the MIT licence (see `LICENSE`). The files `page-structure.ts`, `lib.ts`, `cursor/common.ts`, `sync-plugin.ts` and `index.ts` differ from the upstream source.
